# Torquemade

> Torquemade is an independent web and software studio in Bordeaux, France (founder: Loan Rembeau). It builds custom websites and e-commerce storefronts, bespoke CRM systems, and real-time ERP-to-e-commerce inventory synchronization for legacy systems (SAGE 100, Cegid, Odoo). Primary markets are French-speaking Switzerland (Romandie), Belgium/Wallonia, Brussels, and Luxembourg, with a secondary focus on the US/English-speaking market.

Site is bilingual: every URL below serves both French and English (language toggle on the page). No separate locale URLs.

## Services

- [Custom websites & e-commerce / Sites web sur mesure](https://www.torquemade.com/services/web-dev): Next.js and Shopify builds, mobile-first, SEO-optimized, with custom CRM and API integrations.
- [Custom CRM / CRM sur mesure](https://www.torquemade.com/services/crm): Business management software built around a client's specific workflows, such as bookings, real-time dashboards, and follow-up automation.
- [ERP to e-commerce stock sync / Synchronisation stock ERP ↔ site e-commerce](https://www.torquemade.com/services/erp-ecommerce): Real-time inventory connection between a legacy ERP or point-of-sale system and an online storefront so stock levels stay accurate across channels.

SEO and GEO (generative-engine optimization) content strategy is delivered as part of website projects rather than as a standalone service page; related articles are grouped under the SEO & Contenu category on the blog.

## Products

- [TankLogic](https://www.torquemade.com/tanklogic): A Torquemade sub-brand and inventory-sync software built specifically for mail-order live fish and coral retailers. See its own scoped file at [/tanklogic/llms.txt](https://www.torquemade.com/tanklogic/llms.txt) for product detail.
